issues.description: The reference solution for Aufgabe 02 returns an extra column (Freizeitpark.gemeindeschluessel) that is not requested by the problem. The task explicitly asks for the names and streets of the Freizeitparks and the names of the respective Gemeinden; the solution returns an additional foreign-key column. This contradicts the instruction in the problem statement to output exactly the requested data and may confuse students who compare their results to the provided solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the extraneous column from the reference solution. Change solution_repository/aufgabe02.sql to select only Freizeitpark.name, Freizeitpark.strasse, and Gemeinde.name (and keep the WHERE join). For example: SELECT Freizeitpark.name, Freizeitpark.strasse, Gemeinde.name FROM Freizeitpark, Gemeinde WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Freizeitpark.gemeindeschluessel;
